# Access is a social challenge

Ivo blocks the tower because admitting damage threatens his authority. Mara can appeal to their shared duty directly, or find the strap through the public service hatch and show that this is deliberate tampering, not her faulty repair. Both routes lead to cooperation without requiring a confession.

The hatch is visible from the start and its leather protrudes through the grille. Pulling the loose grille releases the strap; brute force on the door only earns Ivo's warning that the stairs are unsafe. A first hint points to the hatch, a second to the strap caught under the loose grille. Failed attempts cost no unique resource and cannot make the Story unwinnable. The evidence route changes the tone of the later question, not the identity of the culprit.
